references.text: Jesus identifies John the Baptist as the Elijah who was to come.
The disciples ask Jesus about Elijah, and Jesus explains that Elijah has already come in the form of John the Baptist.
The prophecy about one crying out in the wilderness, which is linked to John the Baptist and thus to Elijah.
The prophecy in Malachi that Elijah will come before the great and dreadful day of the Lord.
